observations: The project uses a microservices architecture with separate modules for client, server, and models.
Design patterns like Factory and Singleton are implemented, indicating a focus on object-oriented design.
The absence of manifest files suggests a lack of standardized dependency management.
The project includes both a command-line interface and a graphical user interface, indicating versatility in user interaction.
